text: Every client meeting ends the same way. Hours of typing it all into Intelliflo. Over two hundred hours a year.
So we built Fact Find Writer.
Put in everything from the meeting. The transcript, the handwritten fact find, the photos, even the voice note from the car.
About a minute later, the whole fact find is ready to check.
It follows the conversation. Where the paperwork and the meeting disagree, it shows you both. And if a figure was never given, it waits for it.
Check it, approve it, and it's written straight into Intelliflo.
That's over two hundred hours a year back, for the work only an adviser can do.
The meeting ends. The typing doesn't start.
